nom: Murad Rapid Relief Acne Spot Treatment

avis.texte: Strangely this product gets the job done with my forehead pimples but as soon as I put it on anything below my cheeks I burn. I've burned myself twice now using this, leaves a dried over scab over the pimple. so beware!

This product is absoluely amazing. Its expensive, but so worth it! This is the only product I use for my acne, and it clears it right away. Its also small enough to take on the go! I highly recommend if you get break outs from time to time, and want something quick and easy to apply at night.
This stuff starts working after the first use. it calmed the inflamed pimples and they were practically gone within a day or 2. Im shocked
Significantly cleared up my skin but too expensive to be apart of my daily skincare routine.. if you got the money use it! But I'm a broke college student :(

avis.titre: This is the most effective SA I have tried
avis.texte: I buy this all the time. It helps prevent pimples on my chin. I think I have hormonal acne.
This is a salicylic acid based spot treatment so I use it on those deep under the skin pimples and its amazing. For pimples at the surface I like an AHA or sulfur based spot treatement

This product has been a part of my acne routine since I was 18! This product has never let me down! I highly recommend giving this product a try. JUST A LITTLE BIT is all you need bc a tiny amount of this product goes a long way.

This product does dry out the pimples, however it doesnr pop them, i get whiteheads and itll dry them but wont take the white out. It also does NOT work on deep blemishes which is what i deal with mostly, i kept it to continue use juat to make sure, but i will not be ourchasing this produxt again.

I've tried countless products over the years on stubborn spots, but this showed inprovement with one use! I have reoccuring spots that I hate. Nothing gets rid of them. I couldnt believe the difference one application made. I cant wait to keep using this.

i LOVE this stuff. literally works overnight. i wouldnt say its great for sensetive skin because it can be drying, but holy cow does it tackle those big pimples. ive struggled with acne forever, and this is my holy grail. so much better than any pimple patch on the market. TEN OUT OF TEN

I put this on a large pimple i got on my cheek. Just used a tiny amount and then applied makeup as normal. At the end of the day its half the size and much less irritated! You only need a tiny bit so the tube will last forever. Dont apply this on your entire face!! Its not meant to be used like that. Just a dab on specific spots is all you need. Im so glad it works under makeup so I can wear it morning and night. Super happy with my purchase!

I had a deep cystic pimple on my chin. And it was super painful. I put this on and in a few hours the inflammation went down. I had hormonal acne and I have been using this to help my breakouts and it is very helpful. I highly recommend if you have inflamed acne. I use it when I feel a pimple coming on and it really helps stop it.

the last week i had MASSIVE breakouts on my face that were so painful and stubborn. i put this product on the spots for 3 days and by the 3rd night the pimples were completely gone. this product works like a charm, but it is definitely drying and drys out the area its applied to!
I've used this product 5+ years and continue to be impressed by the quality and effectiveness. It works great as a spot treatment or over a problem area. This is definitely one of my favorites.
This is hands down the best acne product I've ever used. I've been struggling with severe acne for years and after using this for about a week now, I see a dramatic improvement.

I use on any issue. I've used on pre-teen granddaughter for the break-outs at her swimcap hair line and new grandbabies for those little spots that pop up from nursing and pacifier. There's no pain, no smell and no burning! Most spots are gone by morning or that night.

I can't live without this. I usually use the Murad Deep Relief for my adult acne which has worked great but does take a few days to clear things up, and my 3 cysts were absolutely killing me.. bought this praying it would do as it claims and it worked!!!! I woke up today and they're literally 1/2 the size and no longer painful! I will never be without!

I have trouble with the painful, cystic acne, particularly around my chin and if I catch it fast enough, especially when it hurts but isn't visible yet, it'll vanish within a few hours. The sooner, the better but it'll reduce them at any stage. It will make my skin peel after several applications (some of my blemishes are pretty tough). It has a medicine-y type of smell that fades as it dries. I love that it's clear. I'm 44 and wish I had this in my youth!
I put this on a couple spots overnight and they are worse (red and whiteheads) the next day. Is that supposed to happen? :(
I have purchased this over and over again. It truly calms and smooths breakouts within hours.

My skin, usally very blemish free, has been having a meltdown this week and i panic-bought this product. I will never let myself run out of it. It lightened the redness of my blemished, dried them up quickly and now i am on my way to healing from them faster than with no intervention. Would tecommend.
This product is absolutely awful. It ruined my skin. This product caused my pimples into white heads underneath my skin. I can not pop them and has caused bad scarring on my face. DO NOT RECOMMEND!
This is a great adult acne product I have not found anything that works better
Helps with acne spots, I use for open pimples and this treatment helps clear up and keep bacteria OUT! Need this in my routine.

avis.titre: If you need help with acne fast this is it
avis.texte: My sister and I both use this product and it definitely does its job. Treats our acne quickly yes sometimes it does sting but then it goes away. Worth the money and helps easy your mind about how noticeable your acne is. Within 2 days our acne was gone. Sometimes the bigger spots take a few days but you can definitely see the difference in our faces.

I had adult onset cystic acne for years until my esthetician used murad products on my face, she recommended their acne treatment line. I had tried everything and nothing worked and most products actually made my acne worse! Not Murad products..... with continued use my acne cleared up in a matter of days!!! I also have sensitive skin and none of their products irritate my skin. I won't use anything else on my face. If your like me, give it a try..... it's worth it.
I have had acne since I was 13, and I have tried everything. Even acutane didn't work, but this product cleared my acne in 3 days!! 3 days! Please buy this product it is amazing!
It is great for redness it does as it say it makes blemishes reduce size in 4 hours I love this products.

When you apply this, it immediately absorbs into the skin, you dont feel a sticky layer of it sitting on your skin -it absorbs quickly into the acne and does its job of unclogging the oil that caused the acne.. which is why this works so well. I applied it around 4 am and my pimple was gone by 9 am.

I fought stress- related, painful, cystic acne on my chin for 2 years and couldn't find anything to help me until I was shown this product + the clarifying cleanser. I've been using both for 5 years now. This spot treatment works quickly and effectively on my hyper sensitive, combo- oily skin. I will say that on my deeper, stress induced breakouts, I have to apply much more product (2 thick layers) and this does cause some peeling post-pimple. However; the pain is gone when I wake up and the size of the pimple is significantly reduced (or gone, if I applied in time) the next morning. I've found that it doesn't play well with my foundation, so if I'm desperate, I have to give it more time to absorb than I my moisturizer. Pros far outweigh these minor inconveniences now that I've learned how to work with it!

Frist things first, I have sensitive skin and I used the product alone with no other treatment. I purchased this for my hormonal pimples. I used it two night in a row. I did feel the swelling go down but that's about it. My skin peeled in those areas so noticeably. Additionally, it created these massive dark spots in the areas. I would rinse the areas in the morning because of the salicylic acid. I feel like it just clogged my pore extensively and extended the life of the pimple. I got this maybe 4 weeks ago and one of the pimples just popped with pus and so much blood. Maybe I used it incorrectly but its probably not suitable for hormonal pimples.
I think this product works best on very flared up pimples and makes them less red and swollen. It hasn't worked on any pimples under my skin and am still looking for a product that does.

I know it says it takes four hours but that really isn't true. However, I reapply after four hours during the day or I usually put a spot on before bed. The next day it's almost completely gone but ALWAYS ALWAYS ALWAYS close to being gone.

the only reason i give 4 stars is because (at least for me) it doesn't reduce the look and size of zits within a few hours, BUT it does over night!!!! very dependable, this product has never let me down

It burned my skin. The next day the top layer of my skin dried and peeled off. It has too much Salcytic Acid concentration for me. I use the .5% Salcytic Acid creamy face wash from Murads without a problem. I love the creamy face wash at .5% but not this.
I've used many came spot treatments in my life and it's so hard to find a good one for sensitive skin. I'll leave this one on overnight and my spots are gone in the morning! It's worth the price

I've had acne breakouts the past year from wearing a mask. I purchased drug store brands that didn't work. The Murad Acne Control Rapid Relief Acne Spot Treatment reduced the size of my blemish within a couple of hours. This is the best product I've found for maskne. I will definitely buy this spot gel again.
Given a sample from a dermatologist and now have this in my spot control arsenal. A bit pricey if used regularly, but great product.

I got one of those lovely, credible skincare video Internet ads one day and remember the actress in the video saying "Murad doesn't work." In what universe does this not work? I don't have the worst skin in the world, but I am a "victim" of the "show-up-overnight" pimple. This got rid of it so fast (seriously in one day), and it looks like it was never there. I use this twice a day, but cleanse once a day so things aren't so harsh for me (I would say I have combo skin). I would definitely give Murad a try if you're struggling.
I use it a couple times a day and my pimples dry out and vanishes.

If you have sensitive skin, I don't advise you to buy this product. When treating my spots,it left red marks and made my acne appear worse (probably due to the witch hazel,which can be irritating). Just beware, other than that I just don't recommend it, personally if you want something quick and effective
I had a very painful huge white head by my mouth and bought this product thinking it would help and it did absolutely nothing. I actually went and got my money back

My daughter absolutely loves this product! It works super fast and makes those pimples almost disappear overnight. I was amazed the difference the morning after she put it on her problem spots the night before.
I used to used Mario B drying lotion and it wouldn't do much. This right here helps remove pimples right when you feel them coming on. I would recommend even with cystic acne.
I bought this for my pimples and there gone I just leave this on over night and then next morning they are gone (on put on pimples)

avis.titre: Left red marks wherever it was placed
avis.texte: I put it on my breakouts before bed and when I woke up my breakouts were still there but with a red outline from where I placed the spot treatment. It must've burned my skin around the pimple
Made my face super dry to the point where it became super itchy for days. I will not be buying this product again.
I used this product every other and it clears most of my acne.

I tend to use this when the pimples are just popping up or are just under the skin. I put this on at night and then the next morning, the baby pimples are gone. Not magic, but close enough for me. For pimples that have come to a head, i tend to use drying lotion, since this product takes a few days to make those go away.

I used this product for a week I did like it at first but I'm not sure what happened but it started to burn and I started using it less and only on major acne spots. It recently started to burn and I ignored it only to be left with a huge white spot on my face that looks like it can be popped under the skin. Also it peeled my skin making it really dry and sore I'm not sure what happened but I stopped using it. This was the first product in my life to ever do this.

avis.texte: This is one of my favorite spot treatments. It does not over dry your skin, I like salicylic acid in my spot treatments and I also like that this helps to reduce redness.

This product has decreased redness and size of acne on my forehead and chin overnight! I am surprised. Most spot treatments I've tried seem to help some but not as dramatically as this one has for me. I have sensitive combination skin and only used a small amount.

avis.titre: Feel like I have my face back!
avis.texte: I've struggled with acne breakouts since quarantine started. My face is really sensitive and wearing a mask all the time did not help. I would spray my mask the the Murad Salicylic spray - which has helped some but I would still break out. This spot treatment has cleared up my skin in a week!! I finally feel like myself again! Will never go without this product 🥰

Amazing product!! I have hundreds of dollars in breakout products due to wearing a mask, this is only product that keeps my skin beautiful again!! I wish this product was available when I was a teenager!!!

avis.titre: I am never without this product!!!!
avis.texte: Small amount on breakout is all that is needed. It is the best pimple product ever used.
I use over night and it helps reduce the size of my breakouts without drying it out!
This does what it promises , it is really drying so only use it as spot treatment to avoid irritation
I have been using this before bed for MONTHS for cystic acne and white heads. Instead of it taking weeks for painful spots to go away, it takes days.

I would not recommend using this item. I bought this item to get rid of two pimples on my forehead. Instead it burned my skin off and leaving two separate two degree burns on my forehead. I contact Ulta and never heard back. Extremely disappointed, would not buy.
I LOVE this spot treatment. Big cystic type pimples half the size the next day thanks to this guy. Definitely a must have in my skincare bag.
I use this product in the evening as blemishes occur. Been using for over 3 years. Works better than some prescription topical meds I've been on for acne.
Wash face use 1 or 2 a day will dry pimple and cause dry patch
I use this whenever I have a pimple that's very noticeable & the next day it goes down after using this. I highly recommend this product!!!!!

avis.titre: Idk why it's not working for me :/ beware!
avis.texte: I got this because I was in store looking for pimple stickers (I usually use the cosrx ones and they are miracle workers) and they didn't have stickers but the associate recommended this. She said it clears her acne in a matter of days so I got it to give it a try. I had a bit of a whitehead forming a bit deeper under my skin so I put it on. It drained the majority of the pimple but it left a red scar where the pimple was. I thought maybe I used it wrong so I tried again with another pimple. Not only did this other pimple get bigger and more painful the next day, but after the second night/by the third day, my pimple had so much red scrapping around it and it didn't drain. I left it until my cosrx would arrive in the mail, but unfortunately before they got to my house, that pimple's outer scabbing flaked off and now I'm sure it'll leave a scar. I'm really upset because right in the middle of my cheek so I hope it'll heal and not leave too much damage. But yea, I wouldn't recommend this at all. I don't even have particularly sensitive skin, and this just burned my skin right off.
It starts working on my occasional cystic acne with the first application. It doesn't dry my skin out like other treatments I have tried in the past.

This works better than my custom curology. I have bad hormonal acne and stress acne. This takes care of both and reduces the marks from old acne. It can be drying so I recommend using a moisturizer or hydrating serum with it. I also have porse that are so easily clogged it's not funny. This doesn't clog them at all.

avis.titre: This is AMAZING! LOVE! LOVE! LOVE IT!
avis.texte: I'm a first responder and with the current situations I'm required to wear a mask for 12+ hours. This has caused my face to break out with the increased sweating. I bought this product and in 24 hours not only myself but my husband even said your acne is 75% gone! I've used this for right at a week and my skin is back to looking smooth. I highly recommend anyone to purchase! It's worth every cent and more in the amazing way and short time it cleared my skin up!
Only after a couple uses, my acne shrunk so much I could barley see them any more!

I've always struggled with acne growing up especially through the puberty years. My face stays mostly oily but can also be considered combination skin type. I have fairly large pores that I'm constantly trying to maintain. With that being said, I do get some pretty deep, painful pimples every now and then. This is what I use for that problem and it works WONDERS! Sometimes, I'll have a painful but not visible pimple coming up that I'll apply this to morning and night. Typically, it works best at night. When I wake up, it's usually completely gone. The only issue I would be concerned about is that after that area has cleared, it does cause some flakiness for a few days. As mentioned earlier, I have mostly oily skin so it's not a huge issue for me but I could see it being an issue for other skin types. I would recommend this product for oily skin types and some combination skin types.

My mom had an extra and gave it to me so I could try it out, let's just say it was... not what I expected. The smell is not that pleasant, and whenever I rubbed it on my acne it burned my skin? I never saw any improvement too, I used it for two weeks and finally threw it away. To each their own though, many people have said it's worked but this just isn't for me.
I got it because it had amazing views but it made my acne worst.

I bought this as a last hope since I've tried so many acne treatments that do not work. I put it on the night that I bought it and the following morning I noticed that my acne has calmed down and didn't look as bad as it did the day before. I 10/10 recommend this product.
Soo pleased with this product! I struggle with hormonal acne and this really helped get rid of it. It does tend to burn, but it's just doing it's job!
Burnt my skin after one day of using it!! Made my acne worse and literally gave me acne marks.
Best stuff I've used to clear stubborn acne and the price is totally worth it.
I have very bad cystic acne break outs that leave behind terrible scars. This stuff really does prevent breakouts and calm active acne. I use it with the Rapid Spot Gel every night

I will be returning this item. I suffer with cystic adult acne & this item made my skin feel like it was burning & actually irritated my skin more than it already was.

My new favorite spot treatment! It will burn but only for about 5 minutes after applying. Will take a couple uses to actually diminish the pimple so I sometimes use it multiple times in one night after an hour or so. Works best on the pimples that have no whitehead yet.
If you have sensitive skin like mine DO NOT USE this product it will dry the pimple overnight but it will burn the skin around !! It is not worth the money I paid for it

This is the best product I have found for getting rid of pimples quickly. I mostly only get hormonal acne so I only use this for a few days each month but I notice a huge difference after using it twice a day for about 2 days.
I've struggled w hormonal cystic acne and this really helps reduce it !

I've been using for about 2 months now and this product is making my acne 10x worse than before! I have no idea why this is happening but I can't use this any longer with hopes it will finally start working
Great product got it for my daughter and we saw results overnight! Amazing just wish it was a little bigger.
My dermatologist prescribed something for small non-cancerous growths. Didn't touch them. This stuff works almost overnight. LOVE IT!

avis.titre: Perfect addition to acne skin care routine

My skin has looked better, but then I added this spot treatment to the end of my routine, and my skin has never looked better! The ingredients are perfect for treating acne, and I will never be without thiS!
i had red acnes that had been there for 2 months and ever since i used this those ances gone almost completely
This worked well when I had a zit that had not surfaced yet, it got rid of the pain in less than a day. But if you have a pimple that already has a white head it does nothing for it.

I have been using this stuff for years, and so has my teenage daughter. Unfortunately I still break out in my 30's ESPECIALLY during my cycle. I get cystic acne around that time and this stuff works wonders to shrink them. I use this stuff on small pimples too. I've found that this stuff and some ice will really shrink stubborn acne overnight.

This product works amazing. I put it on my pimples that are read and big, and they go down within 4 hours of putting it on. Not much works for my skin, but this is amazing and doesn't irritate my skin.

avis.titre: Right to the core of the problem

I can't do my skincare without this. When I switched to a Murad skincare routine, I had the clearest skin of my life. Now it's all I ever want to put on my face. I feel like this on a spot for 24 hours, it's gone, or seriously reduced.

Never have I had such clear skin right now since I was a young girl before puberty. This spot treatment legit saves me from my acne prone skin! Helps in soothing the incoming acne and also helps prevent! Thank you!
Been using since I was 14 still the only thing that works for my sensitive skin
I decided to try it and do not regret it. Within 4 hrs the bumb is gone
I get outbreaks from my monthly cycle. I applied a small amount to a pimple on my face. It was gone the next morning. I will continue using this product as needed.
My new go-to spot treatment. A little pricey for a small tube but I find it works much better than drug store spot treatments so it's worth it.

avis.titre: AMAZING!! Better then Mario drying lotion!
avis.texte: Literally performs miracle! I saw it working after one use!!! My new holy grail!

This little thing is really expensive but very much worth it. I have very acne-prone skin, and it gets rid of breakouts in like two days at MOST. It does sometimes make my skin a little red after wearing it to bed, but it goes down like 10 minutes after I wash my face in the morning

I had used the Skin Perfecting Lotion from the Murad acne line and absolutely loved it! I would wake up and my skin would look bright, the redness of acne would be reduced and my skin would look so smooth! So when I saw that Murad had a 30-Day Acne kit with a bunch of sample sized products I had to try it. This product in particular is in the kit and it's a miracle worker. Whenever I felt one of those under the skin, painful cystic zits coming on I would put this on it and the pain starts to go away and the zit never grows into a huge nightmare, it just goes away. But with that being said, I also have to be cautious not to touch my acne or mess with it like I'm tempted to do. So between using this product and exercising self control not to mess with my face, this stuff really helps!!
this product really works dries out your pimple so make sure to moisturizer but super duper works with getting rid of pimples

I just got this & used it last night, and had to write a review cause it is amazing. I'm 30 and still struggle with acne due to my very oily skin and easily-clogged pores, and it's particularly bad when I'm stressed or on my period. Put this on my pimples after my usual routine, woke up this morning and every one was significantly smaller, less red, etc. I know other reviewers said it dried them out, but if you've got really oily skin like me, I don't think you'll have to worry. And I used such a small amount that I think this tube could easily last me most of a year.
This product really gives rapid relief... I apply at night and wake up the next morning without any soreness, and a noticeable difference in my breakout.

avis.titre: Good but will dry your skin!
avis.texte: I have really oil skin and my skin is never dry,however after using this on a few zits I noticed that they did go down in size and redness but it also dried those spots of my skin so much! It's good but becareful

avis.titre: I am always going to have this product stocked!

I had bought this before and the pimples I had disappeared overnight. I truly was shocked with the results. I wasn't expecting much but oh boy did I get a lot out of it. It will exceed your expectations. It did for me anyways.
I was told to buy this during a facial. I'd used it before but thought I'd give it another go. It's fine, but not great for the price. I prefer the Mario Badescu Drying Lotion.

woke up one morning with a really painful, large, cystic pimple under the skin with no head to pop and a ton of redness and swelling. I definitely recommend . My friend who works at Ulta recommended the Murad spot treatment. She use it too when she gets an occasional pimple . Last week I had red pump on my chin .
